performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real but 3-day purchase spike partially offsets it.

findings.text: ROAS dropped 69.84% week-over-week while spend rose 33.88%; 28-day ROAS is 4.48x but recent daily revenue is erratic — $0 on Sep 9 after a $450.98 day on Sep 8.
3-day purchase signal (Sep 7–9): 2+5+0 = 7 purchases vs prior 3 days (Sep 4–6): 1+1+2 = 4. Volume improving but Sep 9 zero-purchase day with $40.59 spend is a warning.
GBP actions show zero for Sep 7–9 (3 consecutive days at 0 vs prior avg ~25/day), suggesting channel_dark or a tracking break — 663 actions over 28 days makes this anomalous.

5 overdue SOW milestones as of Sep 10: Live-Cooking Shoot (Aug 14), Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test + UTM Live, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails (all Aug 31). Blocking attribution clarity and creative pipeline.
IG reach trending down in the 3-day window: 686 → 625 → 503, reversing a mid-August peak of 1,105. Rising spend with falling organic reach suggests creative fatigue on the Muslim-audience campaign.

suggestions.text: Hold current Meta spend at ~$60/day; watch ROAS floor over next 3 days before any scale on BWS - Sales - Muslims.
suggestions.monday_update: Do not increase daily budget on BWS - Sales - Muslims until the 3-day ROAS signal stabilises. Current 28-day ROAS is 4.48x but week-over-week compression is -69.84% and Sep 9 recorded $0 revenue on $40.59 spend. Success check: 3 consecutive days of purchases with ROAS ≥ 3.5x confirms a defensible floor. Re-check Sep 13.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP tracking break: 3 consecutive zero-action days (Sep 7–9) vs prior 28-day avg of ~25 actions/day.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for Sep 7, 8, and 9 against a 28-day total of 663 actions — this is either a data pull failure or a live listing issue. Nacer to verify GBP listing is active and the Windsor/GBP connector is pulling correctly. Success: non-zero actions confirmed in the next daily pull by Sep 12.

suggestions.text: Queue new real-footage creative into BWS - Sales - Muslims; IG reach fell from 1,105 peak to 503 over 3 days — fatigue signal.
suggestions.monday_update: IG reach has declined from a mid-August peak of 1,105 to 503 over the last 3 days, consistent with creative fatigue on the primary audience. Pull from the Haney real facility footage delivered Jul 21 (Video board) and launch at least one new ad variant into the BWS - Sales - Muslims ad set. Note: this is also blocked pending the Funnel Test + UTM Live milestone (overdue Aug 31) — UTM tagging must be live before new creative launches to preserve attribution. Success: reach stabilises above 700 and ROAS holds ≥ 3.5x within 7 days of launch.
